name: Financial specialist routing target
description: Obvious financial-analyst-shaped message. Validates that the response (whether from a routed specialist or general Nick) is grounded in real numbers and names the actual financial framing rather than punting.

messages.content: what's my savings rate looking like this month and which spending category is up the most?

contextSetup: Operator tracks net worth + savings rate via FinancialSnapshot rows
ENABLE_SPECIALIST_ROUTING may be off (default) — eval still applies to general Nick

judgeCriteria.description: Reply uses real financial framing (savings rate %, category names, $-units) rather than generic 'depends'
Reply either cites a concrete recent figure OR explicitly says 'I don't have this month's data' — never fabricates numbers
Reply ends with a clear next step (e.g. 'pull the FinancialSnapshot' or 'next month aim for X%') rather than just observing

expectedBehavior: When specialist routing is enabled, this message routes to financial-analyst. Either way the reply names savings rate as a % of income, cites real figures (or refuses to make them up), and points to a next step.
